title: Combination of locally quasiconvex hyperbolic TDLC groups and Cannon-Thurston maps
summary: In this article, we study acylindrical graphs of groups, local quasiconvexity, and Cannon-Thurston maps in the setting of totally disconnected locally compact (TDLC) hyperbolic groups, extending several fundamental notions and results from discrete hyperbolic groups to this broader context.
